description: This file defines a PHP class 'QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams' within the 'OrangeHRM' project. The class extends a base filter parameters class and specifies sorting behavior for education qualification search filters, including a constant for allowed sort fields and setting a default sort field.

classes.name: QualificationEducationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class used to encapsulate filtering parameters for education qualification searches, including sorting configuration.

methods.name: __construct
